agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was tried first and exhausted against the tree's own assets: environment_learning_v1 already learns a tabular model by acting, systematic_exploration_v1 already replaces random walks and never pays twice for a pair, environment_reuse_v1 already replays a prior and detects drift, inert_action_prior_v1 already carries an inertness prior (measured: 36.1% of actions inert, and INERT_ACTION_PRIOR_20261116_V1 measured the prior buying exactly nothing), and k6_target_relative_decision_quotient_v1 already decides when two states may share an action. None of them had ever measured what ONE demonstration licenses -- the domain of the demonstrated sequence against what the agent can perceive -- so the claim 'do it once and it is learned' had never been falsified on a closed environment where the ground truth is fully known.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Independent personnel verification is still open.

expected_parent_change: One demonstration stops being a claim about the environment and becomes a guarded plan with a measured domain: on 168 real states of a real repository its true domain is 112 (status-level goal) and 56 (goal with a premise the plan does not set); under a status-level sense 24 of 168 premise-task states are undecidable, 16 of them failing silently while looking exactly like states where the plan works; carrying the premise in the sense moves that to 0 with the domain unchanged, while command output as a sense collapses 168 states into 3 classes and licenses none.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The permanent object is the premise check and the verifier, not the demonstration: a learned sequence may be proposed but never licensed, the guard is the premise read on the live state, the postcondition is the goal read after the last action, and where neither is expressible the honest move is refusal or a new observable -- because the undecidable set is invariant to experience.
explicit_user_authorization: Instant learning in new arbitrary environments is solved perfectly; one-shot learning plus permanent retention equals all computer use and most advanced SWE -- answer whether that is true.
Research must be exhausted before building, in the project and on the web; own weights only, no model used as a component.
The best part is no part.
Build everything in the branch; merge once when the feature is complete.
falsification_condition: Any demonstration counted as learned knowledge without its domain measured; any 'lucky' state counted as licensed; any undecidable set reported without the sense it was measured under; any claim that more demonstrations close an undecidable cell; any capability, benchmark or terminal credit; any run reported without the number of executed transitions and whether the model was truncated.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The barrier to general capability is no longer candidate generation but the premise: what one demonstration teaches is a domain, and whether the agent may trust that domain is decided by its senses, which is a thing to engineer rather than to wait out.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The plan saves search but never carries authority; the postcondition check costs one parse and one name scan per application and removes the 71 silent corruptions by construction.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The same protocol applies to any state, including a GUI window: re-observe, re-prove the premise, act, re-read.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Plain replay is wrong 53.5% of the time and silently wrong 31.1%; a fingerprint alone still admits the 4 zero-drift stale cases; one plan per state is unbounded and still unproved; a model is prohibited producer cognition.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: On 168 real states of a real repository, the best single demonstration of a real task has a true domain of 112 states for a status-level goal and 56 for a goal with a premise it never sets; under a status-level sense 24 of 168 premise-task states are undecidable, 16 of them failing silently while looking exactly like states where the plan works; carrying the premise in the sense moves that to 0 with the domain unchanged; command output as a sense collapses 168 states into 3 classes and licenses none of them.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Guarding instead of remembering: check the plan's premise on the live state before the first action, check the goal after the last, and where the premise is not expressible in the available senses, make it observable or refuse -- because the undecidable set does not shrink with more attempts.

recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It is the only route that answers the claim on a closed environment where the ground truth is fully known: the model costs |S|x|A| real transitions once, after which every sense is scored on the same states for free, which is what turns 'one try is not enough' into a number and a lever -- the same code path for a git command and a GUI action.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It replaces a list with a fold over experience and reuses the existing repair primitive, the corpus oracle and the hashing/verification discipline; the only new machinery is induction and the rung classifier, and both are measured.
